title: St. Philomena's College Central Library & Digital Commons
description: Established in 1946, the St. Philomena's Central Library houses over 50,000 print volumes, automated with Koha Integrated Library Management Software, RF-ID security gates, and digital access to over 6,000+ international e-journals through N-LIST and DELNET.

digitalResources.name: UGC N-LIST Consortium (INFLIBNET)
digitalResources.desc: Direct remote access to 6,000+ e-journals and 1,99,500+ e-books for all enrolled UG/PG students and faculty.

digitalResources.name: DELNET (Developing Library Network)
digitalResources.desc: Inter-library loans, document delivery services, and access to union catalogs across 7,000+ libraries.

digitalResources.name: NDL (National Digital Library of India)
digitalResources.desc: Access to millions of educational resources in multiple Indian and foreign languages sponsored by MoE.

digitalResources.name: Shodhganga & Shodhgangotri
digitalResources.desc: Open access repository of Indian electronic theses and dissertations submitted to universities.
